row:
Hi I'm Dr. Jasmine Shanelle, a veterinarian, and my passion is pets! I truly believe that Life is Better with Pets. I created this channel to help you simplify pet care and enhance your life with pets. Living with pets doesn't have to be difficult and through education, our companions can be fun, enjoyable, and extremely rewarding. I want to help you reach your pet goals, whatever those may be. Whether you are sharing your life with a pet for the first time or they've been there for as long as you can remember, this channel is for you.

Subscribe to my channel for videos on living with and raising happy, healthy pets, and much more. Because almost everyone can agree, Life Really is Better With Pets!

 Follow me @dr_jasmineshanelle to see the topic for the week!
